continuation: original frozen deterministic Lattice+SAC until native done

feature_schemas.A0: CURRENT535 + absolute physical action2, frozen OLD control only

training.regression: SmoothL1 on advantage / fit-only weighted RMS
training.normalization: fit-only weighted input mean/std(min.001), label weighted RMS(min1); no label mean shift
training.weights: each scene equal, each origin equal inside scene, each candidate equal inside origin; pair weights balance valid origins/maps
training.LOMO: 8 fixed folds, seven fit maps train, one fit map test; fixed300 epochs; no inner-stop early stopping

knn.distance: block-normalized Euclidean of current535,baseline2,delta2; fit-only normalization
knn.weighting: fit scene/origin/candidate weight divided by distance(min1e-6)

A0_lomo_scope: Frozen A0 already trained on all8fit maps. Show as in-sample reference, NOT an independent LOMO model. No new absolute-return refit.
selection: Once, inner-stop4: pair accuracy DESC,Top1Regret ASC,ModelGain DESC; stable tie linear before MLP; KNN not eligible. No old seen-validation data.

gate.lomo: For inner-stop-selected A2 kind: accuracy CI lower>.5,Spearman CI lower>0,ModelGain CI lower>=0; do NOT use leaked A0 LOMO as a held-out comparator.
gate.inner_stop: A2 accuracy point>.5,Spearman point>0, paired Top1Regret improvement vs frozen A0 point>0, ModelGain>=0, selected_negative no greater than A0.
gate.validation: Only if BOTH prior gates pass: freeze selected model SHA; preregister6 unused maps/12origins from110000..110999, seed20261118, before50/150. No scene replacement.
gate.final: Accuracy CI lower>.5,Spearman CI lower>0,Regret improvement vs A0 CI lower>0, ModelGain>=0, selected-negative increase CI upper<=0, gains not single-map-dependent; never deploy in this offline task.

bootstrap.unit: whole map; origins averaged inside map
